data.title: The map beside the canal

memoryNodes.cue: The building is next to an artificial waterway.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 建筑紧邻一条人工水道。

memoryNodes.cue: One road goes beneath the hill and another reaches the parking area.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 一条路从山下穿过，另一条通往停车区域。

memoryNodes.cue: The site depends on more than its own front door.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 这个地点依赖的不只有自己的前门。

data.situation:
Before her next shift, Lin joined a public visit to the old mill centre. The centre was situated beside a canal, a short walk from the square. On a map by the bridge, she traced the route from the station. One road passed through a tunnel beneath the hill; another led directly to the car park. Jo was waiting beside a bicycle rack, holding the plan for the building visit. Jo: People used to come here for factory work. Now they come for classes and events.
Lin: The map shows much more than the building.
Jo: Yes. It is an urban site, so the plan also considers paths, roads and drainage. That infrastructure affects how people reach us.
Lin: I can see why the bridge matters as much as the front door. Today’s visit
Meet beside the canal bridge. Walk past the car park to the marked entrance. The exhibition is in the completed west wing. The main building remains closed for construction work.

readingBlocks.zh: 下一次轮班前，林参加了旧厂房中心的公众参观。中心位于运河旁，离广场步行不远。在桥边的地图上，她沿着车站过来的路线看。一条路穿过山下的隧道，另一条直通停车场。乔拿着建筑参观计划，在自行车架旁等候。

Lin: The map shows much more than the building.
Jo: Yes. It is an urban site, so the plan also considers paths, roads and drainage. That infrastructure affects how people reach us.
Lin: I can see why the bridge matters as much as the front door.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：以前大家来这里是到工厂上班，现在来上课和参加活动。
林：地图上远不止这栋楼。
乔：是的，这里是城市里的地点，所以计划也考虑小路、道路和排水。基础设施影响大家怎样到达。
林：我明白桥为什么和前门一样重要了。

glossary.zh: 为航运或供水等用途修建的人工水道；运河
glossary.note: 可数名词；本例人工水道。
glossary.example: The centre stands beside a canal.

externalEvidence.definition: long and narrow strip of water made for boats or for irrigation

glossary.example: The centre is situated beside the canal.

glossary.zh: 穿过地下或山体等的通道；隧道
glossary.example: The road goes through a tunnel beneath the hill.

externalEvidence.definition: a passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars)

glossary.zh: 供车辆停放的场地或建筑；停车场
glossary.note: 英式常用car park，美式常用parking lot。
glossary.example: Visitors walk past the car park.

externalEvidence.definition: a lot where cars are parked

glossary.example: The mill is an urban site.

externalEvidence.definition: located in or characteristic of a city or city life

glossary.zh: 支持地区运作的基本设施与系统；基础设施
glossary.note: 通常不可数；可包括交通、供水等系统。
glossary.exampleZh: 计划考虑当地基础设施。

externalEvidence.definition: the stock of basic facilities and capital equipment needed for the functioning of a country or area
